title: BioBERT: a pre-trained biomedical language representation model for biomedical text mining
summary: the aim of this article is to introduce text mining , which is the extraction of biomedical text from the internet in order to provide relevant information to the biomedical research community . <n> it is the first step to improve the quality of biomedical research literature and to increase the visibility of the research articles in google scholar , science direct , scopus , web of science , and psycinfo databases .
key_findings: Introduction of BioBERT as a pre-trained biomedical language model
Enhancement of biomedical text mining capabilities
Improvement in the visibility of biomedical research articles
methodology: The article presents a novel pre-trained model, BioBERT, specifically designed for biomedical text mining tasks.
limitations: Limited to biomedical text and may not generalize to other domains
Dependence on the quality of the input data from the internet
future_work: Exploration of BioBERT's application in various biomedical tasks
Integration with other data sources for improved research outcomes
